PRIVATEBY DEFAULT
01

Overview

No account. No remote profile.

Motivational Clock Alarm works primarily on your iPhone. The current app does not require you to create an account, and we do not sell personal information.

This policy explains what the app stores, why iOS permissions may be requested, and the choices available to you.

02

Information stored on your device

Your morning setup lives locally.

Your alarm times, repeat days, goal selections, wake-up messages, completion history, preferences, and selected or recorded videos are stored in the app’s local storage on your iPhone.

If you remove the app, iOS may remove this local information. The app does not provide a cloud backup or account-based restore service.

03

Permissions

Access is tied to an action you choose.

Alarm access

Used to schedule and operate alarms at the time and on the repeat days you select.

Photos

Used when you choose an existing video for a motivational alarm.

Camera and microphone

Used only when you decide to record a new motivation video with sound.

You can review or change these permissions at any time in iOS Settings.

04

Analytics and advertising

Your attention is not the product.

The current version does not include third-party advertising, cross-app tracking, or third-party analytics SDKs. Personal alarm media is not uploaded by the app to an advertising platform.

05

Your control

Change it. Remove it. Revoke it.

You can edit or delete alarms from the app, change permissions in iOS Settings, and remove the app and its locally stored information from your device.

The app is not directed to children under 13 and does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

06

Changes and contact

When the app changes, this page changes.

We may update this policy when app behavior or privacy practices change. The effective date at the top of this page will identify the latest version.

For privacy questions, use the developer contact listed with Motivational Clock Alarm on the App Store or visit the support page.
